Our Foundation

MAKARIOS Initiative

A registered non-government entity, passionately serving grassroots communities since 2017 with dedicated medical and humanitarian expertise.

🤱

Safe Passage Initiative

Improving life expectancy of women, especially those of childbearing age by curtailing maternal mortality through comprehensive healthcare programs.

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦

Child & Family Support

Comprehensive support programs for children, orphans, and widows, ensuring no family is left behind in their journey toward a better life.

🎓

Education & Empowerment

Youth and female educational programs featuring skill acquisition, talent development, and professional training for sustainable livelihoods.

🏥

Health & Wellness

Health enlightenment campaigns, family planning, reproductive health programs, and environmental health initiatives for healthier communities.

👧

Girl Child Protection

Gender development initiatives and comprehensive girl child protection programs ensuring equal opportunities and safety for all young women.

🤝

Strategic Partnerships

Collaborative efforts with government agencies and fellow NGOs to maximize impact and create sustainable humanitarian solutions.

Educational Resource

Kika's Examination

A compelling narrative designed to instill moral courage and academic integrity in the next generation.

₦5,000 per copy

Building Moral Resilience

Based on a true-life story, "Kika's Examination" follows a young girl's journey to stand firm against examination malpractice. It is an essential tool for parents and educators to discuss values and the importance of honest achievement.

🛡️

Moral Resilience

Help children stand against unethical academic practices.

Leadership Team

  • Dr. Patrick Nwachi

    Founder & Director

    Dr. Nwachi pioneered MIHHD's mission of integrating holistic medicine with humanitarian service, drawing from two decades of clinical excellence as a Family Physician.

    As the visionary behind the Safe Passage Initiative, he has revolutionized healthcare delivery in underserved communities by prioritizing compassion alongside medical expertise.
